flutter_secure_storage_windows: The Windows side of flutter_secure_storage, vendored in mobile/packages (DPAPI in Dart, without the C++ plugin that needs ATL): a federated implementation for windows only
screen_retriever: Brought by window_manager; plugin platforms linux, macos and windows only
screen_retriever_linux: Brought by window_manager through screen_retriever; linux only
screen_retriever_macos: Brought by window_manager through screen_retriever; macos only
screen_retriever_platform_interface: The Dart interface of screen_retriever, imported by it only
screen_retriever_windows: Brought by window_manager through screen_retriever; windows only
window_manager: The window of Immuch360 Desktop; plugin platforms linux, macos and windows only, imported under mobile/lib/desktop only
